fields.statement: At 500c4d63, built go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza and ran it by hand in a fresh scratch repo with RHIZA_* unset. In one change set: set thing statement a->b, unset acceptance, set statement again ->c, retire gone --reason obsolete, add fresh under thing, link fresh relates-to thing. change diff printed 'updated capability thing / acceptance: ok -> unset / statement: a -> c' (one before/after for two sets), 'retired capability gone: obsolete', 'created capability fresh' with every field and no old value, and 'added link relates-to fresh thing'. After landing acceptance on thing in another change set (--record), the diff still showed only this change set's 'statement: a -> c' and 'acceptance: ok -> unset'. A pure mv of a node printed 'moved capability solo' with '@key: z -> r'; unlink printed 'retired link relates-to parent2 solo'. change diff --json and api call change.diff '{}' were cmp-identical. go test -run TestScripts/(change-diff|describe-golden) passes.

At 500c4d63 with a scratch build in a fresh repo: a landed four-line statement l1/l2/l3/l4 set to l1/L2/l3/l4/l5 in a change set gave, under '  statement:', exactly '      l1', '    - l2', '    + L2', '      l3', '      l4', '    + l5', so one - and one + for the changed middle line around the unchanged lines; single-line fields kept the 'a -> c' form. go test ./internal/changeset passes.

At 500c4d63 with a scratch build in the same scratch repo: change show ended with a '## Changes' section holding the same text as change diff, including 'statement: a -> c' for the updated statement and the line diff. rhiza tui app change-show --once was cmp-identical to change show --json and held the changes. go test -run TestScripts/tui-write-apps passes.
